fieldNotes.truckGate: fenced dock court with gate hardware/posts at the court throat off the Capps Rd cul-de-sac; PepsiCo wayfinding sign at the entrance (2025-06 SV) directs trucks to 'Shipping & Receiving / Visitors / Market & Gate Office'
fieldNotes.guardShack: the entrance sign names a 'Gate Office' (staffed gate function) but no freestanding booth is visible in sat or SV - the office may be integrated in the building corner; guardShack=true on operational evidence, flagged
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: gate throat sits ~50m off the public cul-de-sac; a 2-3 truck queue would spill into the cul-de-sac (dead-end street, low traffic, so impact moderate)
fieldNotes.dockDoors: numbered dock doors visible in SV on the NE face (numbers into the high teens); ~20 estimated
fieldNotes.dropArea: small trailer group at the S corner lot (~8-10); the trailer rows east of the access road belong to the neighboring building and were excluded
fieldNotes.siteIdentity: building fascia carries PEPSICO branding (2025-06 SV); new ~126k sq ft DC built after the NE Portland plant demolition (VLMK/Perlo project pages); operates as Pepsi Northwest Beverages
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Clackamas industrial district inside the Portland metro fabric -> Urban; site backs onto the Clackamas River greenway
